headline: Abu Dhabi partners with Ultrahuman on smart-ring health data and biological-age model
summary: Smart-ring maker Ultrahuman is partnering with the Abu Dhabi government to roll out its biological-age model across the UAE, with both sides spending the next two years on research and clinical validation. Abu Dhabi also wants to incorporate Ultrahuman's wearables data into its public health app.
